Sign Up Free

Start today, no credit card. Free tier available forever, whether you're a GM or player.

Pick your Game

D&D, Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, or 1,200+ others. Hundreds of free adventures available.

Find your Party

Invite friends with a link, or find a group on our LFG tool and Discord. Solo? We've got options for you too.

Play

That's it. No downloads, no hosting, no setup. Just click and play. New to TTRPGs? Check out our tutorials.

Customize Your Game

Automate Rolls & Actions

Save time with macros. One click for complex rolls, spell effects, and character actions. Works for any game system.

Character Sheets for Every System

Built-in sheets for 250+ game systems including D&D, Pathfinder, and more. Or design your own.

Advanced Customization (Optional)

For power users: Full API to extend Roll20. Add new features, automate campaigns, and more. Pro subscription required.

Create gorgeous maps in minutes with our integrated Dungeon Scrawl tool. No art skills needed.
